title: Warn that already-open apps won't appear in a newly-added Global Menu widget until they're restarted
line: Adding the Global Menu widget now shows a notification saying that apps already open will show their menus there after a restart.
explanation: Qt's platform theme only exports an application's menu if a global menu is already registered when the app creates its window, so apps that were open before the widget was added keep their own menus and the new widget stays empty, with nothing telling the user why. The widget now sends a "Global Menu Added" notification, like the existing "Widget Removed" one, when the user adds it in edit mode, explaining that open apps need a restart.

commits.message:
applets/appmenu: tell users that open apps need a restart when added

Applications only export their menus if a global menu was already there
when they started, so a newly added widget stays empty for them. Show a
notification when the widget is added in edit mode explaining this.

BUG: 519751

patches.diff:
From 492749d3f9540c3342859863c05e12c12b3a4f99 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 20:10:37 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/appmenu: tell users that open apps need a restart
 when added

Applications only export their menus if a global menu was already there
when they started, so a newly added widget stays empty for them. Show a
notification when the widget is added in edit mode explaining this.

BUG: 519751
---
 applets/appmenu/CMakeLists.txt    |  1 +
 applets/appmenu/appmenuapplet.cpp | 18 ++++++++++++++++++
 2 files changed, 19 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/appmenu/CMakeLists.txt b/applets/appmenu/CMakeLists.txt
index afc2651059..a802b66646 100644
--- a/applets/appmenu/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/applets/appmenu/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -22,6 +22,7 @@ target_link_libraries(org.kde.plasma.appmenu PRIVATE
     Plasma::Plasma
     KF6::WindowSystem
     KF6::I18n
+    KF6::Notifications
     PW::LibTaskManager
     dbusmenuqt
 )
diff --git a/applets/appmenu/appmenuapplet.cpp b/applets/appmenu/appmenuapplet.cpp
index 79c29a7e32..65fe567e9a 100644
--- a/applets/appmenu/appmenuapplet.cpp
+++ b/applets/appmenu/appmenuapplet.cpp
@@ -7,6 +7,11 @@
 #include "appmenuapplet.h"
 #include "appmenumodel.h"
 
+#include <KLocalizedString>
+#include <KNotification>
+#include <Plasma/Containment>
+#include <Plasma/Corona>
+
 #include <QAction>
 #include <QDBusConnection>
 #include <QDBusConnectionInterface>
@@ -65,6 +70,19 @@ AppMenuApplet::~AppMenuApplet() = default;
 
 void AppMenuApplet::init()
 {
+    // Apps only export their menus if a global menu was already there when they started
+    if (Plasma::Containment *cont = containment()) {
+        connect(cont, &Plasma::Containment::appletCreated, this, [this, cont](Plasma::Applet *applet) {
+            if (applet != this || !cont->corona() || !cont->corona()->isEditMode()) {
+                return;
+            }
+            KNotification::event(KNotification::Notification,
+                                 i18nc("@title:notification", "Global Menu Added"),
+                                 i18nc("@info:notification", "Applications that are already open will show their menus here after they are restarted."),
+                                 icon(),
+                                 KNotification::CloseOnTimeout);
+        });
+    }
 }
 
 QAbstractItemModel *AppMenuApplet::model() const
--

media.caption: Dolphin open, Global Menu added to the panel in edit mode: no hint at all
Same steps with the fix: a notification explains open apps must be restarted

review.text: This implements what Nate decided in c6. The cause is the client-side Qt platform menubar export, which only checks once at window creation, so a hint is the agreed fix. The notification is sent only when the user adds the widget in edit mode, so restored widgets and scripted layouts stay quiet. It is small, follows the existing 'Widget Removed' pattern, and the screenshots show it.
